body.statement: For one Choi--Yuan missing block with dimensions \(N_o\) and \(T_o\), missing-group size \(\vartheta_o\), i.i.d. centered homoskedastic sub-Gaussian noise, incoherence, signal, spectral-size, and missing-block conditions as stated in their Appendix A, Proposition A.4 gives, with probability at least \(1-O(\min\{N_o^{-9},T_o^{-9}\})\), a simultaneous entrywise linear expansion of every target imputation error into its donor-column and observed-row terms, with the maximum entry remainder bounded by a common constant times the three-term expression used here as \(R_{gk}^{\mathrm{CY}}\) after setting \((N_o,T_o,\vartheta_o)=(N_{gk},T_g,n_g)\).

attestation.note: Verified directly against the Proposition A.4 environment and Appendix A assumptions in the arXiv v1 TeX source; the carrier states only the one-block conclusion used here.

body.justification: This is the published one-block remainder premise used only for the source-submodel finite union bound.
body.gap: The cited proposition is not a growing-block or heterogeneous-noise result.
body.consumer: It supplies the blockwise failure probability in thm:uniform-influence.
